llm_response.reason: The website matches multiple scam criteria: external warnings from BBB/Forbes/McAfee about fake Labubu sites; lack of credible business info or contact details (only form, no phone/address); ambiguous/boilerplate About Us; mismatch in context (mentions sneakers, actually sells toys); free shipping/returns as psychological lure; recent proliferation of scam reports tied to exactly such domains; security (SSL) certificate issues; and exploitative use of viral toy trend tactics. These factors, plus confirmation from trusted authorities, confirm this as a fraudulent shopping site.
